lines.text: NVIDIA: Jensen Huang resigns as CEO; Colette Kress is interim CEO, Harvey Jones first board chair
Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens, rolling out globally
Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small open weights under Apache 2.0 (594B total, 17B active)

feed.headline: NVIDIA: Jensen Huang resigns as CEO; Colette Kress named interim CEO, Harvey Jones first chair
feed.why: The board named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO and Harvey Jones its first chair. Shares closed at $166.19, down 4.34%, on 12 Nov. Earnings remain set for 17 Nov.

feed.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens, rolling out globally
feed.why: API id gemini-4-hydrogen, 1,048,576-token context, $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens. Google says it is rolling out globally; only Cloud pages say GA.

feed.headline: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small weights under Apache 2.0 (594B total, 17B active)
feed.why: Weights are on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0. The model is 594B total and 17B active. The main NVFP4 checkpoint needs at least 500GB of GPU memory.

feed.headline: SpaceX plans more than $74B of supercompute campuses in Texas and Arizona
feed.why: More than $24B at Starbase in Texas, with on-site power, and about $50B in Cochise County, Arizona. The Texas site will not draw from the public grid.

feed.headline: Nonprofits sue Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceXSI to freeze more advanced models
feed.why: Four groups, including Public Citizen, filed in San Francisco Superior Court seeking a freeze on more advanced models. This is a filing, not a ruling.

feed.headline: Anthropic opens self-hosted Claude Managed Agents in private beta
feed.why: Companies run the server and session history themselves, and can send model calls to Anthropic, Bedrock, Google, Microsoft Foundry, or their own gateway.
